description: Use when an agent or a holder wants an Ethereum token or Uniswap v4 hook watched: hourly observations for 7 days, one prepaid term with no renewal and no recurring charge, a stop control, and opt-in Telegram alerts on owner, upgrade, fee, pause, supply or liquidity changes and on checks that stop working. Returns the baseline and a manage token. Run by NIGHTSHIFT's Watchtower crew. The paying wallet owns the watch. Pass the x402 payment as `payment`.

address.description: ERC-20 token or Uniswap v4 hook address on Ethereum

holderWallet.description: The wallet that will pay, for the holder price (50% off). Holders pay half: a paying wallet that holds 500,000+ $SHIFT (in the wallet plus staked), a NIGHT FROG or a Night Watcher gets NIGHTSHIFT house checks and reports at 50%. Fast lookup holder prices have a $0.001 minimum. Swarm Desk orders cost the full quoted price. Ask with holder=<that wallet> (MCP: holderWallet) to get the holder terms, then pay from that wallet.

payment.description: x402 payment: the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload for this call's terms. Leave it out to get the terms.

name: watchtower_watch
title: Watchtower: 7-day watch ($1, half for holders)
